title: When the Verdict Breaks Revisited
author: Petra Okonkwo
blurb: Xanthe Galloway, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
